projectSummary: Harms and boundary context: the injury has consequences for return to weight training that a functional score does not capture. The population is post-operative, so it is indirect for a healthy-lifter page and is never presented as rehabilitation advice.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; surgical case series with survey follow-up, no comparison group, no exposure denominator.

study.intervention: Retrospective case series with patient survey.
study.population: A prospectively maintained institutional database was reviewed for all patients undergoing pectoralis major tendon repair from 2010 to 2016; 44 patients (73.3 per cent) were available. Patients were surveyed on pre- and postoperative sport participation, intensity, maximum weight repetitions in exercises using the pectoralis major, and ASES and SANE scores. Level of evidence 4.

title: Analysis of Return to Sport and Weight Training After Repair of the Pectoralis Major Tendon.
